tasks.title: Sliders
tasks.note:
FAILED
- B12: at the slider's normal 20 px thickness the handle outline is not closed. Horizontal QSlider 180x20 (and vertical 20x180), value 30: the handle rect from subControlRect is (19,-1, 20x20), so the outline is drawn at y=-0.5 (x=-0.5 for vertical), outside the widget. In the grabs the horizontal handle has no top border and the vertical handle no left border: pixels (58,0)/(58,1) and (0,122)/(1,122) are background #fbf8ef while the opposite sides are Dark at (58,18)/(18,122); the handle also sits 1 px off-centre. With a 40 px thick slider the outline is complete. Expected: a closed Dark handle outline fully visible inside the widget at the slider's normal size (also at sizeHint 84x20 / 20x84). Everything else holds (0 images, groove Mid fill + Dark outline, handle Button fill + Dark pen).
Evidence: scratchpad t11/ (slider_horizontal*.png, slider_vertical*.png, pixels.txt).
